kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننعتل (form VII)
# نَنْعَتِلُ (nanʕatilu) /nan.ʕa.ti.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْعَتَلَ (inʕatala)
# نَنْعَتِلَ (nanʕatila) /nan.ʕa.ti.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَتَلَ (inʕatala)
# نَنْعَتِلْ (nanʕatil) /nan.ʕa.til/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْعَتَلَ (inʕatala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
